children: Knife River posted investor presentation highlighting growth strategy, headwinds, and a TTM Adjusted EBITDA of $501.6M.
Filed Form 8-K disclosing presentation materials on investor website for use in investor meetings and presentations.
Reported TTM Adjusted EBITDA of $501.6M and Adjusted EBITDA margin of 15.2% (TTM ended 6/30/26).
Noted 2Q headwinds: fewer public bid lettings, weather delays, higher fuel costs; estimated 2H26 contracting margins ~9–10%.
Outlined actions: right-size crews/equipment, collect fuel surcharges, accelerate private projects and pursue private construction opportunities.
Highlighted growth plan: acquisitions (100+ historical), organic investments (capacity projects through 2027) and vertical integration benefits.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Knife River posts Sept. 2026 investor presentation, provides updated outlook and TTM adjusted EBITDA details
